name: Ragnarok: Believe
source:
Evangelina is searching herb for cure Kyrie's body. Reva can't accompany Evangelina until gets the herb because he needs to go immediately. When searching herb alone there is an assassin targeting Evangelina.

[From The Official site (Removed)]
translation:
伊万杰琳正在寻找治疗基莉身体的草药。丽娃无法陪同伊万杰琳，因为她必须立即离开。独自寻找草药时，一名刺客盯上了伊万杰琳。

[译自官方网站（已移除）]
